question: How do I evaluate a RAG system?
answer: To evaluate a RAG system, assess its retrieval accuracy, generation quality, latency, and resource usage.

course_context.usage: Teams use RAG system evaluation in development and quality assurance to ensure optimal performance.

workflow: Define evaluation metrics for retrieval and generation.
Collect a dataset for testing the RAG system.
Run the RAG system on the dataset.
Measure retrieval accuracy and generation quality.
devops_application: DevOps teams use evaluation metrics to ensure RAG systems meet performance and quality standards.
